REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - MAY 6, 2026 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 6.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact City of Cerritos ADA/504 Coordinator, Drew Schneider, at (562) 916-1314 at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Regular Planning Commission Meeting
May 6, 2026
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703

PRESENT:  Commissioner Deepak “DJ” Jhaveri
  Commissioner Jose “Armin” Reyes
  Commissioner Riaz Surti
  Vice Chair Kiritkumar Chauhan
  Chair Benjamin Ao

PRESENT:  Assistant City Attorney Shukan Patel
  Acting City Engineer Jared Lee
  Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña
  Senior Planner Jeremy Loh

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Vice Chair Jhaveri.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Planning Commission were declared present.

4.  Presentation of Plaque

  A plaque was presented to the outgoing Planning Commission Chair, Jose “Armin”
  Reyes.

5.  Annual Reorganization of the Planning Commission

  Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña declared the position of Chair of the
  Planning Commission vacant and called for nominations.

  Chair Reyes nominated Vice Chair Jhaveri for Chair. Commissioner Surti
  seconded the nomination.

  Vice Chair Jhaveri nominated Commissioner Ao for Chair. Commissioner
  Chauhan seconded the nomination.

  There were no other nominations, and nominations were closed.
  Chair Reyes withdrew his nomination.

City of Cerritos  May 6, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 1
   MOTION: Vice Chair Jhaveri nominated Commissioner Ao for Chair. Commissioner
  Chauhan seconded the nomination.

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chauhan, Reyes, Surti, Jhaveri, Ao
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Commissioner Ao was declared Chair of the Planning Commission.

  Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña declared the position of Vice Chair of
  the Planning Commission vacant and called for nominations.

  Chair Ao nominated Commissioner Chauhan for Vice Chair. Commissioner Reyes
  seconded the nomination.

  Commissioner Surti nominated himself for Vice Chair. Seeing no second to the
  motion for nomination, Commissioner Surti’s nomination failed.

  There were no other nominations, and nominations were then closed.

  MOTION: Chair Ao nominated Commissioner Chauhan for Vice Chair.
  Commissioner Reyes seconded the nomination.

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Jhaveri, Reyes, Surti, Chauhan, Ao
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Commissioner Chauhan was declared Vice Chair of the Planning Commission.

  To allow the Chair and Vice Chair to take their new seats at the dias, a meeting
  recess was called by Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chair Ao invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed on
  the agenda.

  Cerritos resident Sam Desai provided comments congratulating the Commissioners
  on their service to the City and expressing the importance of the Cerritos Center for
  the Performing Arts to Cerritos and its residents.

  Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to address the Planning Commission, Chair
  Ao closed public comments.

City of Cerritos  May 6, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 2
 7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Wednesday, April 1, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Regular Meeting Minutes.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Jhaveri, and seconded by Vice Chair
  Chauhan, to approve the Wednesday, April 1, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission
  Regular Meeting Minutes.

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Jhaveri, Reyes, Surti, Chauhan, Ao
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF CONDITIONAL
  USE PERMIT 2026-1, A REQUEST BY SIAM WELLNESS AND SPA TO PERMIT A
  MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENT USE WITH STATE-CERTIFIED MASSAGE THERAPISTS AT
  20110 PIONEER BOULEVARD, SUITE D, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE
  SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED AREA DEVELOPMENT PLAN EIGHTEEN (ADP-18) (APN
  7055-017-023).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  A staff report was given by Senior Planner Jeremy Loh. A PowerPoint presentation
  was displayed, providing details about the proposed full-service massage
  establishment, offering foot and body massage services. Mr. Loh mentioned that
  there is currently an approved massage establishment at the subject location
  offering similar massage services by State-certified technicians, which was approved
  by the City Council under Conditional Use Permit 2018-2, and the current massage
  establishment is relinquishing the space to the applicant. Mr. Loh concluded his
  presentation by stating that no public comments were received regarding the
  proposed project.

  Discussion continued regarding the current massage establishment, and the
  conditional use requirements for new tenants, and shared wall with the recently
  approved Cabrillo Lane residential development.

  Chair Ao opened the public hearing. Applicant Narumon Saelu provided comments
  regarding her Thai massage establishment, and she and her partners hope to do
  business in Cerritos.

  Cerritos Resident David Pylman provided comments regarding his opposition to the
  previous massage establishment, the separation between the massage establishment
  and the Cabrillo Lane residential development, Vice Chair Chauhan’s previous
  request to review signage in the City, and Councilmembers appointments of
  Commissioners.

City of Cerritos  May 6, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 3
   Cerritos resident Sam Desai provided comments regarding the proposed massage
  establishment, offering resources through the Cerritos Chamber of Commerce, and
  encouraged the applicant to invite Councilmembers to its grand opening.

  Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to address the Planning Commission, Chair
  Ao closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Reyes and seconded by Vice Chair
  Chauhan to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2026-15: A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT 2026-1, A REQUEST BY SIAM WELLNESS AND SPA TO
  PERMIT A MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENT USE WITH STATE-CERTIFIED MASSAGE
  THERAPISTS AT 20110 PIONEER BOULEVARD, SUITE D, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA,
  90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED AREA DEVELOPMENT PLAN EIGHTEEN
  (ADP-18) (APN 7055-017-023).

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Jhaveri, Reyes, Surti, Chauhan, Ao
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  Reports

9A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison

  Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña congratulated Chair Ao and Vice Chair
  Chauhan on their new roles.

9B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members

  Reports were given by Commissioner Reyes, Commissioner Jhaveri, Vice Chair
  Chauhan, and Chair Ao.

10.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:20 p.m.

  /s/ Amanda Acuña
  Amanda Acuña
  Secretary to the Planning Commission
